quote.text: It is not that we have a short space of time, but that we waste much of it. Life is long enough, and it has been given in sufficiently generous measure to allow the accomplishment of the very greatest things if the whole of it is well invested. But when it is squandered in luxury and carelessness, when it is devoted to no good end, forced at last by the ultimate necessity we perceive that it has passed away before we were aware that it was passing. So it is—the life we receive is not short, but we make it so, nor do we have any lack of it, but are wasteful of it. Just as great and princely wealth is scattered in a moment when it comes into the hands of a bad owner, while wealth however limited, if it is entrusted to a good guardian, increases by use, so our life is amply long for him who orders it properly.
quote.author: Seneca
quote.aiInsight:
• Parenthood:
    • Recognize that every moment invested in nurturing your child is a seed planted for their future; just as life is generous in time, your dedicated attention fosters growth and character.
    • Be mindful that distractions and trivial pursuits can rob both you and your child of valuable lessons; cherish each shared experience as an opportunity to build a legacy of wisdom and virtue.
  • Leadership:
    • Understand that effective leadership mirrors the wise stewardship of time; investing it well inspires trust and sets a precedent for accountability among those you lead.
    • Embrace the virtue of disciplined time management to focus on meaningful actions; a leader who prioritizes purpose over fleeting luxuries is more likely to create lasting impact.
  • Product Management:
    • Just as life’s true wealth lies in its mindful use, the success of a product is determined by the clarity of vision and careful allocation of resources; every decision should contribute to long-term value.
    • Resist the temptation of unnecessary complexity and short-lived trends; invest your time and efforts in strategic planning and iterative improvements to ensure the product's enduring relevance and impact.
